ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels and 20% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized primarily at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation band along the entire trailing edge. Right lobe displays a dense cluster of black circular spots in the upper-medial region. Left lobe displays sparse black punctate marks and light mottling near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, with jagged peaks most prominent on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the median notch to the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of tan and white circular calcifications (barnacles) on the far lateral tips of both lobes. Two isolated yellowish-orange circular spots are visible in the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, thin, vertically-oriented linear disruptions visible on the white surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parasitic colonization (barnacles) concentrated on the distal margins, particularly the right tip, altering the clean geometric profile of the edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'spray' pattern of high-contrast black dots localized specifically on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe's ventral surface.
